# diyalamp

> diyalamp is a free, open-source native Markdown editor for macOS. Download the 1.92 MB universal Mac installer and edit ordinary Markdown files without an account.

diyalamp 0.1.0 requires macOS 15 or later. One 1,915,883-byte installer supports Apple silicon and Intel. The app bundle used 3,686,400 bytes (3.69 MB) on disk on the test Mac. Markdown files stay in the folder you choose and remain readable in other editors.

## Download and verify

- [Universal Mac DMG](https://github.com/diyalamp/diyalamp/releases/download/v0.1.0/DiyaLamp-macOS.dmg)
- [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/diyalamp/diyalamp/releases/download/v0.1.0/DiyaLamp-macOS.dmg.sha256)
- [Release notes and installation steps](https://github.com/diyalamp/diyalamp/releases/tag/v0.1.0)
- [Source code and issues](https://github.com/diyalamp/diyalamp) under Apache 2.0

Open the DMG, drag diyalamp into Applications, and choose a folder of UTF-8 .md or .markdown files. macOS may ask you to approve the first launch. Writing works offline after installation.

## Mac installer comparison

Checked November 7, 2026. Sizes are decimal MB and measure download transfers. These are Mac installers that support Apple silicon. Launch and editing speeds require separate measurements.

- diyalamp 0.1.0 universal DMG is 1.92 MB. Local editing requires no account or license activation.
- [Obsidian 1.15.0 universal DMG](https://api.github.com/repos/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases/releases/assets/693337944) is 233.2 MB. Local writing requires no account.
- [Notion 7.42.3 Apple silicon DMG](https://desktop-release.notion-static.com/Notion-7.42.3-arm64.dmg) is 136.2 MB. Workspace editing requires sign-in.
- [Typora 1.14.15 Mac DMG](https://downloads.typora.io/mac/Typora-1.14.15.dmg) is 15.2 MB. After the trial, paid activation is required.

[See the measured Mac installer comparison](https://diyalamp.com/alternatives/#mac-downloads).

## Desktop features

- **Local files:** Open a folder and edit the original UTF-8 Markdown files. Save checks whether the original changed on disk before writing.
- **Markdown editing:** Work in the source or edit supported text in the rendered pane.
- **Workspace search:** Search filenames or note text, including unsaved edits in the active note. Use case, whole-word, or regular-expression matching and include or exclude path globs.
- **Connected notes:** Click rendered wikilinks to open existing Markdown notes. Incoming and Outgoing lists follow the active note and include resolved wiki and local Markdown links.
- **Crash recovery:** If diyalamp closes unexpectedly, it can restore edits through its latest checkpoint. If the original file changed, the app lets you save the recovered edits as a separate copy.

## Bring your notes

- **Obsidian:** Open the vault folder as local Markdown. Obsidian offers plugins, Canvas, and a vault-wide graph.
- **Notion:** Export Markdown & CSV and open the resulting folder. Keep the export archive for attachments and database CSVs.
- **Typora:** Open the folder that already contains your Markdown files. Typora offers richer rendering for math and diagrams.

[Compare Markdown editors for Mac](https://diyalamp.com/alternatives/).
